CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.company_trial_state(_company_id uuid) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN c.trial_exempt THEN 'exempt' WHEN c.trial_status IN ('paid', 'extended', 'exempt') THEN 'exempt' WHEN c.trial_status = 'suspended' THEN 'expired' WHEN c.trial_status IN ('active', 'trial') THEN CASE WHEN c.trial_ends_at IS NULL OR c.trial_ends_at > now() THEN 'active' ELSE 'expired' END ELSE 'expired' END FROM public.companies c WHERE c.id = _company_id
